note: A sinkhole cuts the cross street north of J2; turning traffic moves to J1 and J3.
note_ko: 싱크홀로 J2 북쪽 교차 도로가 끊기고, 회전 교통이 J1과 J3로 몰려요.

scenario.name: sinkhole_cross
scenario.title: Sinkhole on a cross street
scenario.description: A sinkhole closes the cross street north of J2 (J2 ↔ N2, both directions) for 30 minutes. North–south traffic at J2 detours through J1 or J3 and the back street, adding turning traffic at the neighbouring junctions — a test of spillover between intersections.
scenario.question: When one cross street is cut, does the extra turning traffic spill over to the neighbouring junctions?

controller.name: max_pressure
controller.label: Max-pressure
controller.description: Every 5 s, gives green to the axis with the larger pressure (cars upstream minus cars downstream, from loop detectors). No timing plan needed.
